name: UUID Generator & Validator
description: Generate bulk cryptographically secure UUID v4 and timestamp-ordered UUID v7 identifiers, validate syntax, and inspect version and variant metadata.
search_intent: Generate UUID v4 / v7 online in bulk, or validate UUID strings and extract version metadata.

inputs.label: UUID version standard
inputs.help: v4 (random RFC 4122) or v7 (Unix millisecond timestamp-ordered RFC 9562)

inputs.label: Hyphen formatting
inputs.help: Standard hyphenated (8-4-4-4-12) or compact without hyphens

calculation: Generation: Uses Web Crypto API (crypto.getRandomValues and crypto.randomUUID). For v4: RFC 4122 bits set version=4 (0100) and variant=RFC 4122 (10xx). For v7: RFC 9562 packs 48-bit millisecond UNIX timestamp into high bits, followed by 12-bit counter/random and 62-bit cryptographic randomness. Validation: RFC compliant regex validates 36-character standard format or 32-character compact format, extracts 13th nibble for version (1 to 8), and 17th nibble for RFC variant (8, 9, a, b). Local browser generation only.
limitations: UUID generation relies on the client system's Web Crypto entropy pool.
Timestamp extraction is applicable only to time-based UUID versions (v1, v6, v7).
Maximum client batch generation is bounded to 100 entries per click to preserve DOM responsiveness.
